anomalies.observed: On the Microcontroller sheet, U1's SPI labels are attached to the wrong GPIOs: GPIO3/ADC1_CH3 is wired to CS0, GPIO4/ADC1_CH4 to SCK, GPIO5/ADC2_CH0 to CS1, GPIO6 to CS2, and GPIO7 to SO.
anomalies.expected: Per the specification and firmware mapping, SCK should be on GPIO5, SO on GPIO10, and CS0/CS1/CS2 on GPIO4/GPIO6/GPIO7 respectively.

evidence.quote: SPI2 on GPIO5/GPIO10, CS pins GPIO4/6/7
Microcontroller sheet: U1 pin labels show GPIO3/ADC1_CH3 → CS0, GPIO4/ADC1_CH4 → SCK, GPIO5/ADC2_CH0 → CS1, GPIO6 → CS2, GPIO7 → SO

anomalies.impact: The firmware will configure and toggle the wrong MCU pins, so the MAX31855 thermocouple channels will not be clocked or selected correctly. Thermocouple reads will fail, likely causing thermocouple faults and preventing normal heater/run control.

parsed.summary: Anomaly detected: the MCU-side SPI bus for the MAX31855 thermocouples is wired to the wrong GPIOs, contradicting the specified firmware pin mapping and breaking thermocouple communication.
